profile.headline: Software Developer at Leidos
profile.summary:
As a motivated and forward thinking innovator, I offer highly skilled, analytical and purpose-driven Full-Stack Web Development, with a committed focus on technology, creativity and customer service.  I am very driven and passionate about learning new programming languages and paradigms.  My strong programming style incorporates a solid blend of technical skill and creative expression which allows me to deliver a unique and effective outside of the box approach that enables me to methodically work to solve highly complex problems.

Technical Skills:

Databases: PostgreSQL, SQL, NoSQL, MongoDB, Mongoose, MySQL

Languages & Frameworks: Java, Python, C++, JavaScript, Spring, ReactJS, AngularJS, Angular 7, Vue.js, Ruby, Rails, Sinatra, Django, API Integration, HTML5, CSS3, jQuery, jQuery UI, Ajax, Express.js, Node.js, Backbone.js, Underscore.js, D3.js, Leaflet.js, Less.js, ECMAScript 6, Bootstrap, RESTful API, Elasticsearch, Apache Solr

Management & Deployment: Maven, Heroku, AWS, RSpec, Jasmine, Git, GitHub, Command Line, Linux (Ubuntu), VMware, Docker, CI/CD

Methodologies: Object Oriented Programming, Microservices, MVC, Test-Driven Development, Design Patterns, Responsive Design, User Stories, ERD, Document Object Model, Debugging, Functional Programming

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed a Full Stack application that consists of a Django (Python web framework) rest API with a React front end that utilized ES6 and accepted user input for software download requests.

positions.title: Data Visualization Software Engineer
positions.description:
Utilized computer forensics, reverse engineering, JavaScript and Go to analyze, decode and interpret Bitcoin Blockchain, Ethereum Blockchain and Leveldb files.

Successfully developed and deployed an internal, CRUD Ruby on Rails inventory management and tracking application with a PostgreSQL database, and an Apache Solr search index.

Enhanced an existing D3.js Reporting Dashboard application with UI/UX modifications, interactivity, and D3.js animations and easing.

positions.title: Data Visualization Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Providing students with crash-course on Python programming and data processing using the advanced libraries of NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, Seaborn, Tweepy and Beautiful Soup.

Training students in introductory and advanced work with SQL (MySQL and PostgreSQL) and noSQL databases (MongoDB).

Assisting the class with the fundamentals of web-development (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) and advanced JavaScript libraries for data visualization (D3.js, Leaflet.js).

Tasked with introducing students to Tableau, Hadoop, Machine Learning and R.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed and supported a highly responsive, mission critical, full stack web application for the eXploit program while utilizing JavaScript, jQuery, jQuery UI, Backbone.js and Underscore.js.

Utilized software development methodologies in the implementation and delivery of next generation Geospatial Intelligence technologies for the National Geospatial Intelligence Agency (NGA).

Tested and deployed code in AWS GovCloud; updated Chef recipes and cookbooks using Ruby.

Strategically focused on harnessing GOTS, COTS and FOSS technologies that delivered advanced exploitation services to NGA through automation and deployment.

positions.title: UI/UX Developer
positions.description:
Supported the USDA/NAL’s Ruby Blacklight discovery index for the Apache Solr index.

Assisted the Knowledge Services Division (KSD) in building content and products intended for public access and display.

Strategically provided intuitive, user-centered Web interfaces for overall usability and customer engagement using HTML, CSS, JavaScript and jQuery.

Focused on iterative development, 508 Compliance, data submission and data discovery (search and browse) capabilities.

positions.title: Web Development Immersive | Full Stack Web Developer
positions.description: Graduate of the WDI12 cohort at General Assembly.  I chose to attend General Assembly based on several key factors.  As a career changer from accounting to web development, I was seeking a place where I would be able to gain solid transferrable skills that I could immediately apply to the workforce.  General Assembly gave me that opportunity.  The program structure was aligned with my career goals, and I'm very enthusiastic and passionate about learning new programming languages.  In summary, attending General Assembly was an excellent choice for my career development and progression as a Full Stack Web Developer.

projects.title: Project 3 - Aceso
projects.description:
Collaborated with a team of Web Development Immersive students to create and deploy a Rails API backend with an AngularJS front end application that searches for information.
Utilized complete RESTFUL routes.
